title: search_urls records a PyPI 404 as no answer, asks PyPI with a space-joined query, and drops a PyPI hit as a hub page
goal: factdiff.search_urls reads a PyPI search as provider.search does: it joins the query with the provider's joiner (provider.search_shape's second value, '-' for PyPI), reads a PyPI 404 as an answer with no hits, not an unanswered search, and keeps a PyPI project hit whose package_url ends in '/' instead of dropping it as a hub page. Found by the SP-vk3wf746 review (S3 factdiff.py:1269, S4 factdiff.py:1283; the PyPI half of the sprint goal's GitHub, arXiv or PyPI clause).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import json,factdiff as f,provider as p;row={'search_api':'https://pypi.org/pypi/{q}/json'};p.gated_request=lambda u,**k:{'status':404,'body':b'','headers':{}};f.search_urls('presidio analyzer returns entities',None,row,'https://pypi.org/project/presidio-analyzer/');a=[r for r in f._unanswered if 'pypi.org' in r];f._searches.clear();f._unanswered.clear();p.gated_request=lambda u,**k:{'status':200,'body':json.dumps({'info':{'name':'requests','package_url':'https://pypi.org/project/requests/'},'releases':{}}),'headers':{}};b=f.search_urls('requests sends http',None,row,'https://pypi.org/project/old/');print(a,b);sys.exit(0 if not a and b else 1)
